problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -3 \\ 4 & -2 & -3 & -4\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-3 & -4 & 0 & 7 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & -2 \\ -3 & -8 & 0 & 3 \\ 7 & 7 & 0 & -10\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations 

- ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}-2{R}_{2}$
- ${R}_{3}:=…$
- ${R}_{4}:=…$

each of the form ${R}_{i}:={R}_{i}+k{R}_{2},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary row operations?
worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries above and below ${a}_{23}=1$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary row operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -3 \\ 4 & -2 & -3 & -4\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}-2{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-3 & -4 & 0 & 7 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -3 \\ 4 & -2 & -3 & -4\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-3{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-3 & -4 & 0 & 7 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & -2 \\ -3 & -8 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & -2 & -3 & -4\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+3{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-3 & -4 & 0 & 7 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & -2 \\ -3 & -8 & 0 & 3 \\ 7 & 7 & 0 & -10\end{aligned}] \\  & =B.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the missing elementary row operations are

$\,$ ${R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-3{R}_{2}\,$ and $\,{R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+3{R}_{2}.$
